Official examples recommend CUDA; macOS CPU/MPS latency, stereo preservation, original-time alignment and guitar-specific quality remain untested.
Review the full custom license for the actual intended use/redistribution before selection.

alternative_candidates.finding: Primary repository code is MIT and offers text-conditioned audio separation; this limited review did not establish artifact-specific pretrained-weight terms. decision: Native/imported-stem work can proceed. No unrestricted, macOS/stereo/quality-verified guitar checkpoint was established here; SAM Audio offers an explicit broader weight license but has a real access/runtime/quality gate. An infrastructure or synthetic metric PASS is not separation completion.
